title: Soundcore
description: Turn wind noise reduction on or off, or toggle it, on Liberty 5 Pro earbuds through Soundcore Actions, the modified Soundcore app. A launch only hands the request over; Soundcore confirms the result with the earbuds and shows it as a toast, but EVA does not see it.
setup: Install Soundcore Actions 0.3.0 or newer (com.oceanwing.soundcore) from github.com/colonelpanic8/soundcore-actions; the official Soundcore app lacks the wind reduction activity this package pins.

Connect Liberty 5 Pro in Soundcore. Soundcore Actions also offers its own background EVA extension, which confirms the change and can read the setting; when it is present, EVA uses it instead of this package.

tool.name: set_wind_reduction
tool.title: Set wind reduction
tool.description: Turn wind noise reduction on or off, or toggle it, on the earbuds connected in Soundcore. Supports Liberty 5 Pro. A successful launch is handoff evidence only: the resulting setting is not reported back.

state.description: on or off sets wind reduction; toggle flips the current setting.

receipts.success: Wind reduction request handed to Soundcore. Soundcore shows the confirmed setting; EVA does not see it.
receipts.handlerMissing: Soundcore Actions 0.3.0 or newer is not installed, or this Soundcore build lacks the wind reduction activity.
